question: Nowadays, more and more women decide to have children later in their life. What are the reasons for this? Do the advantages of this outweigh disadvantages?
essay:
In this day and age, more and more women choose to give birth to children later in their life. This could be attributed to multiple factors, which will be analyzed in the essay below, along the reasons why having kids lately has more disadvantages than advantages.

There are many reasons for this phenomenon. To begin with, the reason often results from the desire to place greater emphasis on professional and academic advancements on the grounds that worrying about the modern world with higher living standards. As a result, in order to have better income and get a better life condition, most of them would trade their private life for their career. Therefore, there is a strong probability that they may choose to have babies later because they have little time left to devote to their life and family. Additionally, most of them find themselves not ready to be a mother and do not know how to bring up a kid properly. Therefore, when they gradually achieve work-life balance, they often have the intention to spend a significant amount of time on learning some skills and techniques to understand more about babies, especially about children’s psychology and health when they are toddler and infants. As a result, after spending much time on the career path, it often takes women a considerable amount of time to prepare before getting pregnant.

However, some disadvantages can be considered as a consequence of having children later. First, giving birth late can result in many health risks related to both mother and their children. Indeed, some birth defects like down syndrome or higher risk of miscarriage are linked to delaying childbirth. As a result, not only the kid but also the mother are likely to be prone to some diseases due to health decline. Besides, the distance between the relationship of parents and the child is also a negative of the choice of delaying childbirth. It is believed that the more late mothers decide to get pregnant, the higher the probability of generation gap might happen between them. More specifically, children whose parents are greatly older than them often find it is hard to get along well with their pareview by virtue of different viewpoints and life perspectives.

In conclusion, the fact that women choosing to delay childbirth is caused by many factors. From my point of view, the disadvantageous effects are much more significant than the benefits it brings to mothers.
